name: number-ticker
title: Number Ticker
description: Animate numbers to count up or down to a target number.

props.name: value
props.description: The value to count to (or from, when counting down).

props.name: startValue
props.description: The value to count from (or to, when counting down).

props.name: direction
props.description: Count up from `startValue` to `value`, or down from `value` to `startValue`.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait after the number scrolls into view.

props.name: decimalPlaces
props.description: Number of decimal places to show.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for `Intl.NumberFormat` (grouping and decimal separators). Addition; Magic UI always formats as en-US.
